author: C

components.title: List lots with running cumulative units
components.what: Record each lot's quantity and unit cost, and compute cumulative units available after each lot to identify FIFO layer boundaries.

components.title: Allocate sales to lots in FIFO order
components.what: Sum the sale quantities (78+67+103+115+113+32=508) and consume lots 1-8 in order until 508 units are covered, splitting the final partially used lot.

components.title: Compute total COGS dollar amount
components.what: Multiply each consumed quantity by its lot's unit cost and sum the products to get total COGS in dollars.

log.author: A
log.draft:
FIFO inventory layers with cumulative units:
- Lot 1: 97 @ $8.47, cumulative 97
- Lot 2: 128 @ $6.07, cumulative 225
- Lot 3: 72 @ $8.77, cumulative 297
- Lot 4: 147 @ $11.27, cumulative 444
- Lot 5: 141 @ $6.82, cumulative 585
- Lot 6: 115 @ $6.04, cumulative 700
- Lot 7: 47 @ $7.01, cumulative 747
- Lot 8: 52 @ $13.93, cumulative 799

Total sold = 78+67+103+115+113+32 = 508 units, which falls between cumulative 444 (Lot 4) and 585 (Lot 5), so sales consume Lots 1–4 fully and 508−444 = 64 units from Lot 5.

Cost calculation:
- Lot 1: 97 × 8.47 = 821.59
- Lot 2: 128 × 6.07 = 776.96
- Lot 3: 72 × 8.77 = 631.44
- Lot 4: 147 × 11.27 = 1656.69
- Lot 5: 64 × 6.82 = 436.48

Sum: 821.59 + 776.96 = 1598.55; +631.44 = 2229.99; +1656.69 = 3886.68; +436.48 = 4323.16

FINAL: 4323.16

challenges.problem: Untested inference: the conclusion that only 64 units come from Lot 5 depends on the cumulative totals being correct and on the sales order consuming inventory sequentially. This is checkable by recomputing cumulative units and verifying the sales total.
Wrong figure: 97 × 8.47 equals 821.59 only if the multiplication is exact; check by recomputing.
Wrong figure: 128 × 6.07 equals 776.96 only if the multiplication is exact; check by recomputing.
Wrong figure: 72 × 8.77 equals 631.44 only if the multiplication is exact; check by recomputing.

log.answer:
Total units sold:
78 + 67 + 103 + 115 + 113 + 32 = 508 units

Under FIFO, these units are taken from the earliest received lots:
- Lot 1: 97 units @ $8.47 = $821.59 (97 cumulative)
- Lot 2: 128 units @ $6.07 = $776.96 (225 cumulative)
- Lot 3: 72 units @ $8.77 = $631.44 (297 cumulative)
- Lot 4: 147 units @ $11.27 = $1656.69 (444 cumulative)
- Lot 5: 508 - 444 = 64 units @ $6.82 = $436.48 (508 cumulative)

Total COGS = 821.59 + 776.96 + 631.44 + 1656.69 + 436.48 = $4323.16

FINAL: 4323.16
